title: How LA Small Businesses Can Land Big Contracts for LA28
description:
Los Angeles is preparing to host world-stage events like the upcoming Super Bowl and the LA28 Olympic Games. City leaders are taking direct action to ensure local small businesses share in the economic gains.

At the Los Angeles Sports and Entertainment Procurement Summit, local entrepreneurs connected with vital resources to secure major contracts. Attendees accessed financial programs and guidance on certifications, including dedicated support for minority- and women-owned companies.

The goal is to help small companies build strong foundations today so they can scale into thriving midsize businesses tomorrow. Even if you missed the event, opportunity is still knocking. Visit the City of Los Angeles Community Investment Department website to access local business tools and prepare for upcoming contract opportunities.

Learn more at https://cid.lacity.gov/
